experiments.scope: The executed Phase C: the embedded enumeration subspace S' of the Phase B output, its fixed chunk-major Gray order, and the index of the first collision. Every trial regenerates the same pair. The replay checks only the output collision; it does not test the declared cost heuristics H3-instruction-conversion or H4-execution-reproducibility, nor Theorem 6.1 (its alpha_2 observations are untrusted).
experiments.hypothesis: The element of S' at the stated enumeration index and its partner under the message difference alpha_0 are two distinct 135-byte messages with equal sha3-256-r5 digests. The replay makes no cost claim: it does not show that no earlier index collides, and Phase C's charge is the bound on pairs actually evaluated by the parallel execution (proof Section 7).
